body.query: Recent corporate action announcements by Bank of America Floating Rate Senior Notes due September 2027, CUSIP 06051GLX5: reverse stock split, CUSIP or identifier change, redemption, or ticker change
body.systemPrompt: You are scanning a watchlist for an investment operations team. Report the most recent corporate action announced for Bank of America Floating Rate Senior Notes due September 2027, CUSIP 06051GLX5, either by the issuer itself or in an official exchange or SEC notice: a reverse or forward stock split, a CUSIP or ticker change, a name change, an ADS ratio change, or a redemption, tender offer or exchange offer for this security. Ignore every other company and every other security. Ignore earnings, dividends, buybacks, share offerings, lawsuits, law-firm advertisements and analyst commentary. If no such action appears in the sources, write none found for event_type and not stated for every other field. Copy dates and times exactly as the source writes them. Write not stated for any field the source does not give. Never infer.

identifier_in_source.description: Ticker or CUSIP of the affected security exactly as the source prints it, or not stated

event_type.description: One of: reverse split, forward split, CUSIP change, ticker change, name change, ADS ratio change, redemption, tender offer, exchange offer, other, none found

terms.description: Split ratio, or redemption price and amount, as stated

effective_as_stated.description: Effective date and time exactly as the source writes it

effective_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the first trading day on the new terms for a split, or the redemption date for a bond, or not stated

new_identifier.description: New CUSIP or new ticker as stated, or not stated

source_notice_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD printed on the notice itself

results.title: Lument Finance Trust Announces Completion of Reverse Stock Split
results.author: Lument Finance Trust, Inc.
highlights:
NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) ("we", "LFT" or "the Company") announced today that its previously announced 1-for-10 reverse stock split of common stock was completed following the close of business today. The Company's common stock will continue to trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "LFT" and, starting on September 10, 2026, will trade on a post-split basis under a new CUSIP number: 55025L306.

Following the close of business on September 9, 2026, every ten issued and outstanding shares of the Company's common stock were converted into one share of the Company's common stock. As a result of the reverse stock split, the number of outstanding shares of the Company's common stock was reduced from 52,564,062 to approximately 5,256,400.

No fractional shares of common stock will be or remain issued, and each stockholder otherwise entitled to a fractional share as a result of the reverse stock split will be entitled to receive in lieu of a fractional share cash in an amount equal to the fraction of a share multiplied by $6.959 The reverse stock split applied to all of the Company's outstanding shares of common stock and therefore did not affect any stockholder's relative ownership percentage or proportional voting power, except for de minimis changes resulting from the payment of cash in lieu of fractional shares.

Stockholders of record will receive information from Equiniti Trust Company, LLC, the Company's transfer agent ("Equiniti"), regarding their stock ownership following the reverse stock split and applicable payments of cash in lieu of fractional shares. Stockholders were not required to take any action to effectuate the exchange of their shares.
